exemptions.rationale: Math-#514 added a reused copy of this theorem whose context opens Set where the original opens Set unitInterval; the copy's single topology import does not provide unitInterval. The statement uses no name from the unitInterval namespace (no scoped I, no sigma, no unitInterval.* identifier), checked against the interface the crawl records at both locations, so the context difference does not change it. Only a change to either interface (the statement or its context: open, variable and the like) re-blocks; comments, whitespace and proof bodies are outside interface_sha256. Remove this entry if the #514 packet owner restores the original context in the copy. Routed at main#738 comments 6568570507 and 6569726362; design 6568753056; wording 6570035707.
